card.fires_on: Mixed positions: a space just before a number such as 8 or 1939, and the start of a proper name such as Camb, Paw or Tu. It also fires on a few words in the animal-dosing sentence about rabbits and organogenesis.

modes.description: The first piece of a split proper name, such as Cambodian, Pawnee or Tuvalu.
